blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Constructing complete 3D worlds from a single panorama is challenging because large portions of the scene remain unobserved. Existing panoramic-video methods expand spatial coverage through dense sequential generation, but neighboring frames contain substantial redundancy, long trajectories accumulate errors, and independently generated directions may be inconsistent. We present WorldExpand, which formulates single-panorama world expansion as the generation of sparse, complementary, and high-resolution panoramic observations. This representation concentrates the generation budget on informative scene regions and preserves the fine-grained details required for 3D construction. WorldExpand addresses two key challenges: where to observe and how to synthesize. Our Coverage-Guided View Selection identifies informative target locations using scene-adaptive quadrants and warp-based coverage scores, while our Joint Panoramic Diffusion uses Gaussian-splatting-based geometric warps to jointly synthesize four pose-grounded and cross-view-consistent panoramas. A diagnostic-guided global--local attention schedule retains global attention only in sensitive layers, reducing the training and inference costs of high-resolution joint generation. The resulting posed panoramas can be directly fed into an existing reconstruction pipeline to build an explicit 3D representation. Experiments show that WorldExpand recovers content behind occluders and around distant corners, improves both novel-view synthesis and downstream 3D reconstruction metrics across various datasets, and generalizes robustly to diverse in-the-wild scenes. WorldExpand runs significantly faster than the state-of-the-art panoramic-video method while producing higher-resolution observations with stronger cross-view consistency.
blocks.zh: 从单一全景构建完整的三维世界具有挑战性,因为大片场景仍然无人观察. 现有的全景-视频方法通过密集相继生成来扩大空间覆盖范围,但相邻的帧包含大量的冗余,长轨积分错误,独立生成的方向可能不一致. 我们介绍《世界扩展》,它提出单一泛泛世界的扩展,作为稀少、互补和高分辨率全景观测的生成。 这一表述将发电预算集中在信息丰富的场景区域,并保留了3D建设所需的精细细节. 《世界扩展》涉及两个关键挑战:在哪里观察以及如何综合。 我们的"覆盖-引导视图选择"(Speed-Guided View Setch)通过场景调整四分仪和曲面覆盖分数确定信息性目标位置,而"联合全景传播"则使用高斯-镀层-几何曲面来联合合成四个姿势基础和相容的全景. 诊断指导的全球-地方关注时间表只保留敏感层次的全球关注,降低了高分辨率联合生成的培训和推论成本. 由此产生的全景可直接输入现有的重建管道,以建立明确的三维代表。 实验显示,"世界扩展"恢复了占卜器后方和相距遥远的角落周围的内容,改进了小说-视野合成和下游的3D重建度量衡,跨越了各种数据集,并强力地概括到多样化的"万事通"场景. WorldExpand的运行速度大大快于最先进的全景-视频方法,同时产生分辨率更高的观测结果并具有更强的交叉视图一致性.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Constructing explorable and geometrically coherent 3D worlds from text or a single image is a long-standing goal with broad applications in immersive content creation and virtual production ( HunyuanWorld, 2025 ; HY-World et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ) , games and embodied simulation ( Gan et al., 2020 ; Savva et al., 2019 ) , and spatial intelligence ( Wu et al., 2026a ; Liu et al., 2025b ; Liu et al., 2026a ) . Video-based novel-view synthesis (NVS) methods extrapolate perspective observations from limited inputs ( Zhang et al., 2026 ; Yu et al., 2024b ; Cao et al., 2025 ; Wan et al., 2025 ; Kong et al., 2024 ) , but their narrow fields of view require multiple directional clips for full angular coverage. An initial panorama—captured directly or synthesized from text or an image by existing panorama generators ( Zhang et al., 2024 ; Feng et al., 2025 ; HY-World et al., 2026 ) —provides full 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} angular coverage in the image domain, where scalable generative priors are readily available, but remains spatially incomplete: its single viewpoint cannot reveal surfaces behind occluders, around corners, or beyond doorways.
blocks.zh: 从文字或一幅图像中构建可扩展和几何相通的3D世界是一个长期目标,在浸入内容创造和虚拟制作中有着广泛的应用(HunyuanWorld,2025;HY-World等,2026;Lu等,2025;Zhou等,2024),游戏和体现模拟(Gan等,2020;Savva等,2019),以及空间智能(Wu等,2026a;Liu等,2025b;Liu等,2026a). 以视频为主的小说-视觉合成(NVS)方法从有限的投入中推断出视角观测(张等,2026;于等,2024b;曹等,2025;万等,2025;孔等,2024),但其狭窄的视野需要多取向片段才能完全角覆盖. 最初的全景——直接取自文字或由现有全景生成器从文字或图像中合成(张等,2024;冯等,2025;HY-World等,2026)——在图像域中提供完整的360X360-Circ]角覆盖,在图像域中,可伸缩的分系前科很容易获得,但空间上仍然不完整:其单一视角不能揭示出奥秘后表面,角落周围或门外.

blocks.en: Expanding beyond this fixed viewpoint requires moving the observation center and synthesizing panoramas at new locations. Panoramic video generation ( Lu et al., 2025 ; Yin et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2024a ; Yang et al., 2025b ) offers a natural route, but existing approaches inherit fundamental limitations from dense sequential generation. In particular, they suffer from two limitations. (i) Redundant information representation : densely sampled consecutive frames encode largely overlapping scene information and thus provide redundant multi-view evidence for reconstruction. (ii) Limited and inconsistent exploration : a single rollout explores primarily along one direction, independently generated rollouts toward multiple directions may disagree in overlapping regions, and errors accumulate over long trajectories, resulting in inconsistent multi-view observations for 3D reconstruction. Consequently, directly adopting the output of video generation as the intermediate representation is not well aligned with the goal of 3D world construction. This raises a fundamental question: What representation can capture maximal information at minimal generation cost while being tailored to 3D world construction?
blocks.zh: 超越这种固定观点需要移动观测中心并在新的地点合成全景。 全景视频生成(Lu等,2025;Yin等,2025;Wang等,2024a;Yang等,2025b)提供了一条自然路线,但现有方法继承了密集相继生成的根本局限性. 他们尤其受到两个限制。 (一)冗余信息表示:密集取样的连续帧编码基本重叠的场景信息,从而为重建提供冗余多视图证据. (二)有限和不一致的探索:一次推出主要沿着一个方向探索,独立产生的推出向多个方向探索,重叠区域可能会有分歧,错误会因长轨而累积,导致3D重建的多视角观察不一致. 因此,直接采用视频生成输出作为中间代表,与三维世界建设的目标不完全一致。 这就提出了一个根本性的问题: 什么样的代表能够以最低的生成成本获取最大程度的信息,同时又适合三维世界建设?

blocks.en: To address this question, we introduce WorldExpand , a framework that formulates single-panorama world expansion as the generation of a sparse set of high-resolution panoramic observations at novel locations. Each panorama captures the full angular context at one location, while a few displaced panoramas provide complementary spatial coverage. Compared with dense video, this representation avoids spending computation on redundant neighboring frames and instead uses the saved budget to increase observation resolution, which is crucial for preserving the fine-grained structures required for detailed 3D reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这一问题,我们引入了WorldExpand(世界扩展),这个框架将单一泛泛世界的扩张形成一个框架,在新的地点产生出一套稀少的高分辨率全景观测。 每个全景都捕捉一个地点的全角上下文,而几个被迁移的全景则提供互补的空间覆盖. 相较于密集的视频,这种表现避免了在冗余相邻帧上花去计算,取而代之的是使用所节省的预算来增加观测分辨率,这对于保存详细3D重建所需的精细结构至关重要.

blocks.en: Given this sparse panoramic representation, two key challenges remain. (1) Where should the new observations be placed? Fixed target directions ignore scene layout and may waste the limited view budget on blocked or redundant regions. Our Coverage-Guided View Selection adapts the quadrant orientation to scene boundaries and selects an informative target in each region. (2) How can we jointly generate consistent high-resolution panoramas? Our Joint Panoramic Diffusion uses Gaussian-splatting warps as geometric anchors and jointly synthesizes all four target panoramas to maintain cross-view consistency. To further eliminate unnecessary computation, we introduce a diagnostic-guided global–local attention schedule. Our diagnostic reveals that not all layers require global attention: sensitive layers retain cross-view communication, while the remaining layers use local attention, substantially reducing the training and inference costs of high-resolution joint generation. The resulting posed panoramas can be directly consumed by an existing 3D reconstruction pipeline ( HY-World et al., 2026 ) to build the expanded world.
blocks.zh: 鉴于这种全景代表性的稀少,仍然存在两个重大挑战。 (1) 新意见应放在哪里? 固定的目标方向忽略了场景布局,可能会将有限的取景预算浪费在被封锁或冗余的区域. 我们的覆盖- Guided View 选择使四角方向适应场景边界,并在每个区域选择一个信息化的目标。 (2) 我们如何共同产生一致的高分辨率全景? 我们的"联合全景传播"采用高斯克-镀斯克瓦斯作为几何锚地,并联合合成了所有四个目标全景来保持交叉视野的一致性. 为了进一步消除不必要的计算,我们引入了一个诊断性的全球-地方关注时间表。 我们的诊断表明,并非所有层面都需要全球关注:敏感层面保留了交叉视野的交流,而其余层面则利用当地关注,大大减少了高分辨率联合生成的培训和推论成本。 由此产生的全景可被现有的三维重建管道(HY-World等,2026年)所直接消耗来建设被扩大的世界.

blocks.en: Experiments show that WorldExpand effectively expands scenes by generating content behind occluders and around distant corners. Across various datasets, it outperforms prior panoramic-video methods on both novel-view synthesis and downstream 3D reconstruction metrics, while generalizing robustly to diverse in-the-wild scenes. Owing to its efficient sparse representation, WorldExpand achieves up to an 8.6 × 8.6\times speed-up over the state-of-the-art method ( Yang et al., 2025b ) , while generating higher-resolution observations with stronger cross-view consistency. In practical applications, WorldExpand provides a useful building block for large-scale roaming, games, virtual environments, and embodied AI simulation.
blocks.zh: 实验显示,"世界扩展"通过在占地者背后和在遥远的角落周围产生内容,有效地扩展了场景. 在各种数据集中,它在小说-视觉合成和下游3D重建度量衡上都超过了前作全景-视频方法,同时将强力地概括到多样化的全景. 由于其高效的零星代表率,"世界扩展"在最先进的方法(Yang等,2025b.)上实现了高达8.6×8.6\时速的加速,同时产生分辨率更高的观测,交叉视野的一致性更强. 在实际应用中,"WorldExpand"为大规模漫游,游戏,虚拟环境提供了有用的构件,并体现了AI模拟.

blocks.en: 3 WorldExpand
blocks.zh: 3 世界扩展

blocks.en: As discussed above, dense panoramic video is an inefficient representation for 3D world construction: neighboring frames contain largely redundant observations, while long or independently generated trajectories can introduce cross-view inconsistencies. Given a single panorama I 0 I_{0} and its depth D 0 D_{0} , estimated with DepthMaster ( Wang et al., 2026c ) for in-the-wild inputs, WorldExpand instead expands it into a coherent 3D world through a sparse panoramic representation designed around the needs of reconstruction ( Figure 2 ). It first selects a limited set of informative viewpoints to maximize complementary scene coverage ( Section 3.1 ), then jointly synthesizes their panoramas while maintaining pose grounding and cross-view consistency ( Section 3.2 ), and finally fuses the resulting observations into a coherent 3D representation ( Section 3.3 ).
blocks.zh: 如上所讨论,稠密的全景视频是3D世界构造的低效表现:相邻的相框包含大部分冗余的观测,而长长或独立产生的轨迹可以引入交叉视图不一致. 根据DepthMaster(Wang等,2026年c)的估算,“世界扩展”则通过围绕重建需要设计的零星全景表将其扩展为一个连贯的三维世界(图2)。 它首先选择了一套有限的信息性观点,以最大限度地扩大场景的互补性(第3.1节),然后联合综合其全景,同时保持布局地平面和交叉视野的一致性(第3.2节),最后将由此产生的观测结果纳入一致的三维表述(第3.3节)。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Overview of WorldExpand. Given one panorama, we select four viewpoints that expose complementary unseen regions, jointly synthesize their panoramic observations with selective cross-view communication, and align multi-view depths to reconstruct an expanded Gaussian scene.

blocks.en: 3.1 Coverage-Guided View Selection
blocks.zh: 3.1 覆盖-引导视图选择

blocks.en: Why Coverage-Guided Selection? At inference time, we back-project the source panorama I 0 I_{0} and its estimated depth D 0 D_{0} into a point cloud 𝒫 0 \mathcal{P}_{0} . Although I 0 I_{0} covers all viewing directions, its single observation center leaves large regions occluded. Random or naive target placement ignores scene layout and source visibility, and may therefore select blocked, redundant, or highly overlapping views that fail to reveal these unobserved regions. Given a limited budget of N = 4 N{=}4 target views, we instead select spatially distributed poses according to their expected coverage of newly exposed content.

Text- or pose-only conditioning lacks spatial anchors, depth-as-color maps are sensitive to distribution shifts, and mesh warping stretches surfaces across depth discontinuities. We instead adopt Gaussian splatting to render geometric warps. Leveraging the accurate poses and depth provided by our synthetic dataset (Supplementary Appendix C ), we unproject the source RGB-D panorama I 0 I_{0} and D 0 D_{0} into a colored point cloud 𝒫 0 \mathcal{P}_{0} , treat each point as an isotropic Gaussian splat, and render the resulting representation from each target pose: ( W i , M i ) = Render ERP ( Δ 𝐓 0 → i 𝒫 0 ) , i = 1 , … , N . blocks.en: To resolve this, we perform a per-layer diagnostic on a fully global-attention model: each layer is individually switched to local attention without finetuning, and the Δ \Delta PSNR is measured against the full-global reference. As shown in Figure 3 , the sensitivity is clearly heterogeneous—localizing certain layers causes severe degradation while many others incur negligible loss. We select the 30 layers with minimal degradation as local layers and finetune the resulting model, achieving comparable quality to the full-global baseline with significantly reduced memory and latency.

blocks.en: 4.1 Datasets

blocks.en:
We evaluate on two complementary panoramic RGB-D benchmarks and a diverse set of in-the-wild panoramas. The RGB-D benchmarks comprise our UE dataset for measuring in-domain fidelity and the synthetic subset of RealSee3D for evaluating cross-dataset generalization.
On each benchmark, we sample 64 64 anchor test cases and expand every anchor into 4 4 target views, yielding 256 256 generated panoramas for image- and geometry-level quantitative evaluation. We further evaluate on diverse in-the-wild panoramas to assess practical generalization when ground-truth depth is unavailable; in this setting, the source depth is estimated using DepthMaster ( Wang et al., 2026c ) .

blocks.en: UE Dataset. Our primary benchmark is a synthetic panoramic RGB-D dataset built in Unreal Engine (Supplementary Appendix C ). It contains diverse indoor and outdoor environments with accurate camera poses and dense metric depth, supporting both point-cloud warp conditioning and ground-truth 3D evaluation.

blocks.en: RealSee3D. To assess generalization to a distinct scene distribution, we use the synthetic subset of the public RealSee3D benchmark ( Li et al., 2026b ) , which provides indoor multi-view panoramic RGB-D data with rendered camera poses and metric depth. This benchmark is held out from training and differs from our Unreal Engine training scenes.

blocks.en:

For 3D reconstruction quality , we measure (i) camera-pose accuracy : the poses of the four target panoramas are estimated with the off-the-shelf VGGT- Ω \Omega ( Wang et al., 2026a ) (each panorama sliced into perspective views) and compared to the ground truth via pose AUC at 3 ∘ 3^{\circ} / 30 ∘ 30^{\circ} ; and (ii) point-cloud geometry : for every method we reconstruct the point cloud with the same Panorama-Aware 3D Reconstruction module ( Section 3.3 ) to ensure a fair comparison, and compare it to the ground-truth point cloud—obtained by unprojecting and merging the ground-truth RGB-D of the source (center) view and the four novel views—reporting Accuracy and Completeness (per-scene mean/median) and F-score@5cm.

blocks.zh: 4.3 实验结果

blocks.en: To our knowledge, no prior work shares the same setting of expanding a scene from a single panorama via multi-view panoramas. We therefore compare against the closest line of work—panoramic video generation—and select GenEx ( Lu et al., 2025 ) and Matrix-3D ( Yang et al., 2025b ) as representative baselines. Notably, both GenEx and Matrix-3D are trained on synthetic scenes rendered in Unreal Engine, so evaluation on held-out UE scenes does not give our method exclusive access to the synthetic-engine domain. Since our multi-view panoramas may correspond to target locations along arbitrary directions, requiring a single panoramic video to cover all of them is unrealistic. For a fair comparison, we instead run each baseline four times, generating panoramic videos along the four target directions independently, and extract the keyframes corresponding to our target viewpoints for evaluation against the ground truth.
blocks.zh: 据我们所知,没有前作通过多景全景从单一全景扩展场景的相同背景. 因此,我们比较了最近的一行工作——全景视频生成——并选择GenEx(Lu等,2025年)和Matrix-3D(Yang等,2025年b)作为有代表性的基线。 值得注意的是,GenEx和Matrix-3D都接受了关于用不真实引擎制作的合成场景的培训,因此对被搁置的UE场景的评价不能使我们的方法独家进入合成引擎领域. 由于我们的多视图全景可能与任意方向上的目标位置相对应,要求一个单一的全景视频来覆盖它们都是不现实的. 为了进行公平的比较,我们每一次运行一次基线,按照四个目标方向独立制作全景录像,并提取与我们的目标观点相对应的关键框架,以便对照地面真相进行评估。

blocks.en: Comparison on UE Synthetic. On our in-domain UE synthetic dataset, our method outperforms both baselines on all NVS metrics ( Table 1 ); the complete per-view results in Supplementary Table 9 further show that this advantage holds across every target view. The PSNR/SSIM gains show our panoramas stay pixel- and structure-level faithful to the source-grounded reference, while the lower LPIPS reflects fewer hallucinated, cross-run-inconsistent structures that would otherwise corrupt downstream 3D reconstruction. This advantage carries over to 3D: because the baselines drift from the source geometry and disagree across independently generated views, both their estimated poses and reconstructed point clouds degrade, whereas our consistency-aware panoramas remain source-grounded and cross-view coherent.
blocks.zh: 比较UE合成. 在我们的域内UE合成数据集上,我们的方法在所有NVS指标上都超过了两个基线(表1);补充表9中完整的每个视图结果进一步表明,每个目标视图都有这种优势。 PSNR/SSIM的增益显示我们全景保持像素和结构级别,忠实于基于源的参考,而低等的LPIPS则反映了较少的幻觉,交叉运行的结构,否则会破坏下游的3D重建. 这一优势延伸到了3D:因为基线从源几何上漂移,在独立产生的观点上存在分歧,它们估计的姿势和被重建的点云都退化了,而我们的一致认识全景仍然是源头和交叉视野一致的.

blocks.en: Comparison on RealSee3D. We further evaluate on the synthetic subset of the public RealSee3D benchmark to probe cross-dataset generalization. Crucially, none of the compared models—neither the baselines nor ours—is trained or fine-tuned on RealSee3D; every method is applied in a purely zero-shot manner. This makes RealSee3D a fair, held-out testbed that measures generalization ability alone, isolating it from any advantage of in-domain training. Under the same protocol, the NVS and 3D reconstruction metrics in Table 1 follow the same trend as on our UE synthetic benchmark: our method improves both image fidelity and reconstructed geometry, showing that the consistency-aware design transfers beyond the training distribution. Additional qualitative comparisons are provided in Supplementary Appendix H .
blocks.zh: 比较 RealSee3D. 我们进一步评价公共RealSee3D基准的合成子集,以探索跨数据集通论. 关键是,在RealSee3D上,没有任何一个比较的模型(无论是基线还是我们的模型)经过训练或微调;每一种方法都是完全零射入的。 这使得RealSee3D成为一个公平,被搁置的测试台,用来单独衡量通缩能力,将其与域内训练的任何优势相隔离. 在同一协议下,表1中的NVS和3D重建度量表遵循了与我们UE合成基准相同的趋势:我们的方法既能改善图像的忠实性又能重建几何,表明一致性感知设计转移超越了训练分布. 补充附录H提供了更多的质量比较。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Qualitative comparison on in-the-wild panoramas. A single video trajectory cannot reach all four directional target viewpoints, so GenEx ( Lu et al., 2025 ) and Matrix-3D ( Yang et al., 2025b ) each generate four independent clips. Their results exhibit ERP distortions, content collapse on diverse wild inputs, and abnormal overexposure, whereas WorldExpand preserves coherent structure and geometric cues across different visual styles. Additional comparisons and analysis are provided in Supplementary Appendices B , G and H .
blocks.zh: 图4:全景内质比. 单一的视频轨迹无法到达所有四个方向目标视点,因此GenEx(Lu等,2025年)和Matrix-3D(Yang等,2025年b)各生成四个独立的相片. 他们的结果显示了企业资源规划系统的扭曲、内容在各种野生投入上倒闭以及异常的过度暴露,而世界扩展则保留了不同视觉风格的连贯结构和几何提示。 补充附录B、G和H提供了更多的比较和分析。

blocks.en: Qualitative Comparison and Reconstruction Analysis. Figure 4 evaluates in-the-wild inputs with diverse scene styles. Because the video baselines require a separate trajectory for each direction, their four clips are generated independently and can suffer ERP distortion, severe appearance drift, content collapse, or unstable exposure. WorldExpand instead generates the four target panoramas jointly and remains robust across these styles while preserving clearer structure and geometric cues. The downstream point-cloud comparison in Figure 5 further shows that these consistent observations produce stable, well-defined 3D structures, whereas Matrix-3D exhibits local collapse and distorted geometry. Controlled comparisons on UE synthetic and RealSee3D, together with further system-level analysis, are provided in Supplementary Appendices B , G and H .
blocks.zh: 定性比较与重建分析. 图4评价了具有不同场景风格的全局输入. 由于视频基线要求每个方向都有单独的轨迹,因此其四个片段是独立生成的,并可能遭受ERP扭曲,严重外观漂移,内容倒塌或不稳定的曝光. 而世界扩展则共同生成四个目标全景,在这些样式中保持坚固,同时保留更清晰的结构和几何提示. 图5中的下游点-云比较进一步显示,这些一致的观测结果产生稳定,定义明确的三维结构,而矩阵-3D则显示局部倒塌和扭曲几何. 补充附录B、G和H提供了对UE合成和Realsee3D的控制比较以及进一步的系统层面分析。

blocks.en: Figure 5: Additional in-the-wild 3D reconstruction comparisons. Across diverse panoramic inputs, WorldExpand produces stable, well-defined point-cloud structures. In contrast, Matrix-3D exhibits local point-cloud collapse and distorted geometric details, reflecting inconsistencies in its generated observations.
blocks.zh: 图5: 额外的 " 内部 " 3D重建比较。 在各种全景性投入中,世界扩展产生了稳定、定义明确的点-云结构。 相形之下,Matrix-3D显示了局部点云倒塌和扭曲的几何细节,反映了其生成的观测结果中的不一致.

blocks.en: 4.4 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 4.4 读取研究

blocks.en: We ablate the key components of WorldExpand to assess their contributions to view coverage, cross-view consistency, generation quality, and efficiency. Supplementary Appendices D and E give further results for joint generation and local attention.
blocks.zh: 我们放弃《世界扩展》中的关键内容,以评估它们为查看覆盖面、交叉观点的一致性、生成质量和效率所作的贡献。 补充附录 D和E为联合组建和地方关注提供进一步成果。

blocks.en: Diagnostic-Guided Global–Local Attention Schedule. Prior panoramic-video methods allocate their computational budget to densely sampled, highly redundant frames, leaving limited memory for high spatial resolution. Our sparse panoramic keyframes instead concentrate this budget on a few high-resolution observations, yielding up to an 8.6 × 8.6\times speed-up for four-direction generation over the panoramic-video baseline; detailed system-level timings are provided in Supplementary Appendix B . However, joint 2K synthesis remains expensive if every transformer layer performs full cross-view attention. We therefore ablate how the number of diagnostic-selected local layers affects training and inference speed, memory, and generation quality. As shown in Figure 6 , localizing more layers steadily reduces cost with only a modest quality trade-off; using 30 of 60 layers as local provides a balanced operating point. Supplementary Appendix E reports the measurements for each layer count.
blocks.zh: 诊断指导全球-地方关注时间表。 之前的全景-视频方法将其计算预算分配到被高采样,高度冗余的帧上,为高空间分辨率留下了有限的内存. 我们的零星全景关键框架将预算集中在几个高分辨率观测上,在全景-视频基线上,四向生成速度达到8.6×8.6分;补充附录B提供了详细的系统级别时间安排。 然而,如果每个变压器层都进行完整的交叉视距注意,联合2K合成仍然很昂贵. 因此,我们减缓了当地选定的诊断层的数量对培训和推断速度、记忆和生成质量的影响。 如图6所示,将更多的层层本地化,仅以适度的质量取舍,稳步地降低成本;将60个层中的30个层作为局部提供平衡的操作点。 补充附录 E报告每层计数的测量。

blocks.en: Joint Four-View Generation. In w/o four-view , we train a single-view variant that accepts only one target warp at a time and independently denoises the four target panoramas without cross-view attention. Qualitatively, joint generation produces more consistent appearance and structure across overlapping regions, as shown in Figure 7 ; additional examples are provided in Supplementary Figure 11 . Quantitatively, it raises the four-view average PSNR from 18.27 18.27 to 20.16 20.16 dB ( + 1.89 +1.89 dB) and SSIM from 0.560 0.560 to 0.658 0.658 ( + 0.098 +0.098 ), while reducing LPIPS from 0.284 0.284 to 0.256 0.256 ( − 0.028 -0.028 ; Supplementary Appendices D and 4 ). Because the ground-truth panoramas are mutually consistent across viewpoints, these gains provide indirect evidence that the generated set more faithfully preserves shared scene content.
blocks.zh: 联合四视一代. 在W/o 四景中,我们训练一个单景变体,一次只接受一个目标曲速,并且独立地将四个目标全景化而无需交叉视角关注. 图7显示,从质量上看,联合生成在重叠区域的外观和结构更加一致;补充图11提供了其他例子。 从数量上讲,它将四景平均PSNR从18.27 18.27提高到20.16 20.16 dB(+1.89 + 1.89 dB)和SSIM从0.560 0.560提高到0.658 0.658 (+ 0.098 + 0.098),同时将LPIPS从0.284 0.284减少到0.256 (-0.028-0.028; 补充附录D和4). 由于地面实况全景在各种观点之间是相互一致的,这些成果提供了间接证据,表明生成的一组更忠实地保存了共享的场景内容.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented WorldExpand for single-panorama 3D scene expansion through sparse, complementary high-resolution observations. Coverage-guided selection, joint panoramic diffusion, and diagnostic-guided attention address incomplete spatial coverage, cross-view inconsistency, and generation cost. Experiments demonstrate improved novel-view synthesis and reconstruction, with up to an 8.6 × 8.6\times denoising speed-up over the state-of-the-art panoramic-video method. These advances address substantial challenges that remain in coherent, detailed 3D world generation.
blocks.zh: 我们通过零星的、互补的高分辨率观测,提出了 " 世界扩展 " 方案,以扩大单层立体场景。 覆盖面指导性选择、联合全景传播和诊断指导性关注涉及空间覆盖不完整、交叉视图不一致和生成成本。 实验演示了改进后的小说-视觉合成与重建,最高可达8.6×8.6\时,对最先进的全景-视频方法进行调试. 这些进展解决了在连贯、详细的三维世界一代中仍然存在的重大挑战。

blocks.en: We focus on static 3D scene generation, where complete spatial coverage, fine detail, and geometric consistency remain open challenges. Extending spatial expansion to dynamic 4D environments, including dynamic-object insertion while maintaining geometric and temporal consistency, is an interesting direction for future research.
blocks.zh: 我们专注于静态的三维场景生成,其中完整的空间覆盖,细微细节和几何一致性仍然是公开的挑战. 将空间扩展扩展到动态4D环境,包括动态-对象插入,同时保持几何和时间上的一致性,是未来研究的有趣方向.

blocks.en: Setup. We build our novel-view panorama generator on a pretrained image diffusion model ( Wu et al., 2025a ) and train it in two stages for joint multi-view panoramic synthesis, with each training and inference step jointly producing four novel-view panoramas. We first train at 1K resolution ( 512 × 1024 512\times 1024 per view) with full global attention for 6,000 6{,}000 steps, which teaches the model to follow the point-cloud warp condition and perform novel-view synthesis; we then fine-tune for 2,000 2{,}000 steps at 2K resolution ( 1024 × 2048 1024\times 2048 per view) with the global–local attention schedule that switches 30 30 of the 60 60 DiT layers to per-view local attention. Thus, all reported main-model trajectories switch from 1K to 2K at step 6,000 6{,}000 . Both stages use a batch of eight training examples per iteration. For the feed-forward reconstruction stage, we adopt WorldMirror2 ( HY-World et al., 2026 ) as the perspective backbone. Each input panorama is sliced into 21 perspective views that uniformly cover the 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} field of view, which are fed into the feed-forward model to obtain globally consistent depth predictions. After known-camera calibration and RANSAC-based scale alignment, the resulting point cloud is used to initialize a Gaussian Splatting ( Kerbl et al., 2023 ) representation, and the final scene is optimized using a gsplat-based ( Ye et al., 2025 ) implementation.

For a controlled comparison in Table 1 , every method uses the same source-view depth wherever geometry is required for view planning, point-cloud warp construction, or final scale alignment. We use rendered ground-truth source depth on both UE synthetic and the RealSee3D synthetic subset. GenEx, Matrix-3D, and WorldExpand are therefore evaluated with identical source geometry and identical selected target poses; no target-view depth is provided to any method, and target RGB-D is used only to compute evaluation metrics. For the in-the-wild qualitative examples, where ground-truth depth is unavailable, we instead predict the source depth using DepthMaster ( Wang et al., 2026c ) . This separates the controlled benchmark protocol from the practical deployment setting with estimated geometry.

blocks.en: Appendix B System-Level Comparison with Matrix-3D
blocks.zh: 附录B 系统一级与矩阵-3D的比较

blocks.en: We compare WorldExpand with Matrix-3D ( Yang et al., 2025b ) in Table 3 . We use the same setup for all runtime measurements. WorldExpand uses a 20B-parameter backbone and generates panoramas at 1024 × 2048 1024{\times}2048 , whereas Matrix-3D uses a 14B-parameter backbone and operates at 480 × 960 480{\times}960 or 720 × 1440 720{\times}1440 . Despite using the larger model and higher output resolution, WorldExpand completes four-direction denoising approximately 2.3 × 2.3\times faster than Matrix-3D at 480p and 8.6 × 8.6\times faster at 720p. This advantage comes from its reconstruction-oriented design: it spends computation on sparse complementary observations, generates them jointly, and directly fuses their posed panoramas. Matrix-3D instead generates a dense 81-frame video for each direction. Most adjacent frames provide little new scene coverage, yet substantially increase generation and downstream processing cost; exploring four directions further requires four independent runs without cross-trajectory communication. Its generation stage is therefore not co-designed to provide a compact multi-direction observation set for reconstruction, and its official reconstruction interface processes one video trajectory at a time.

Matrix-3D转而为每个方向生成密集的81帧视频. 大多数相邻相接的相框提供很少新的场景覆盖,然而却大大增加了生成和下游处理成本;再探索四个方向需要四个独立跑道而不进行跨射线通信. 因此,其生成阶段并非共同设计,为重建提供紧凑的多方向观测装置,其官方重建接口一次处理一个视频轨迹.

blocks.en: Training a pose-controllable multi-pano generation model requires scenes with multiple walking directions, moderate anchor–target disparity, accurate camera poses, and dense depth for warp-based conditioning. Real-world panoramic data cannot reliably provide these properties due to motion artifacts, missing metric depth, and limited trajectory diversity; we therefore construct a large-scale synthetic dataset in Unreal Engine. We next detail the scene collection, trajectory generation, and anchor–target sampling used to construct these tuples.

blocks.en:
Scene and Roaming Trajectory Collection. We curate Unreal Engine scenes with complex meshes and diverse layouts, and build a trajectory generation pipeline. For each scene, we construct navigable regions via NavMesh-based collision avoidance, generate camera paths with Unreal Engine’s random roaming, and filter out invalid cases such as collisions, mesh penetration, short movements, and low-parallax trajectories. We then render equirectangular RGB and depth from a panoramic camera along each valid trajectory, mark sky regions as infinite depth, and record synchronized RGB, depth, and pose annotations. The final dataset contains 76,721 76{,}721 individual trajectories, corresponding to approximately 19.2 19.2 K four-trajectory groups, covering diverse camera displacements and reliable geometric correspondences.
We reserve 30 30 scenes for validation, with the remaining scenes used for training, ensuring no scene-level overlap between splits.
blocks.zh:
场景与罗明轨迹集. 我们用复杂的网格和多样的布局来管理不真实的引擎场景,并建造出一条轨迹生成管道。 对每个场景来说,我们通过基于Navemesh的相机来构建可导航区域,通过不真实引擎的随机漫游生成相机路径,并过滤出诸如相机相机相机穿透、网状穿透、短动和低等参数轨迹等无效案例。 然后我们用一个全景相机 沿着每个有效轨迹 将天空区域标为无限深度 并记录同步的RGB 深度和深度 最终数据集包含76,721个76{,}721个单轨,对应约19.2 19.2个. K四射出相机组,涵盖多相相机相位移和可靠的几何通信.
我们保留30个场景进行验证,其余场景用于训练,确保各场面之间没有场景重叠.

blocks.en: Intersection-Centric NVS Pair Collection. Exhaustively enumerating anchor–target combinations would produce many redundant pairs: very close views have little parallax, while very distant views encourage hallucination. We instead use an intersection-aware sampling strategy. For each scene, we project all camera centers onto the ground plane and detect intersections between trajectory segments. Nearby intersections are merged, and the frame closest to each merged point is used as an anchor panorama. These intersections naturally connect multiple walking directions and provide a reconstruction-oriented center for scene expansion. Around each anchor, we sample four target views from the incoming and outgoing trajectory directions, subject to a valid baseline range and a minimum temporal gap. For each anchor–target pair, we unproject the anchor RGB-D panorama into a colored point cloud, transform it by the relative pose, and render the point cloud at the target view to obtain a warped image and a disocclusion mask that explicitly marks regions requiring synthesis. This intersection-centered design yields approximately 120 120 K effective NVS training tuples.
blocks.zh: 间- Central NVS 平分收藏. 详尽地列举锚-目标组合将产生许多冗余的对:非常近的观点几乎没有偏差,而非常远的观点则会鼓励幻觉. 相反,我们采用了一种交叉认识的取样策略。 对于每个场景,我们将所有相机中心投射到地面平面上,并探测出轨迹段之间的交叉. 相近的相接点被合并,最靠近每个相接点的帧被作为锚地全景. 这些相交路口自然地连接了多条行走方向,为场景扩展提供了以重建为主的中心. 围绕每个锚点,我们从入出轨迹方向抽取出四个目标观点,但以有效的基线范围以及最小的时间间隔为条件. 对于每个锚-目标对,我们解析锚-RGB-D全景为有色点云,通过相对姿势将其转化,并让点云在目标视线上得到一个被扭曲的图像和一个分泌口罩,明确标记需要合成的区域. 这种以相交点为中心的设计产生约120个120克有效的NVS训练Tuple.

blocks.en: Findings. Because each local layer keeps only the per-view noisy tokens, adding more local layers steadily saves both memory and time: at 40 local layers the model reaches 80.9 80.9 GB with a 2.35 × 2.35\times speedup, while 20/30 local layers offer more conservative savings. The accuracy cost of localizing more layers is modest ( Table 7 ): even at 40 local layers, the most sensitive selected layer only drops − 0.71 -0.71 dB in the training-free diagnostic, and after finetuning the model re-adapts to local attention, so the practical degradation is smaller. We therefore localize 30 of the 60 DiT layers by default—an empirical choice that balances efficiency and cross-view consistency—while 40 layers push efficiency further and 20 layers give a more conservative accuracy margin.

blocks.en: Inference Speed-Up. Local attention also shortens the per-view attention sequence at sampling time, so it accelerates inference as well ( Table 8 ): at 40 local layers the profiling latency drops from 66.8 66.8 s to 27.5 27.5 s, a 2.42 × 2.42\times speed-up, and 30 local layers (our default) already give 1.79 × 1.79\times . Each reported measurement sums one conditional and one unconditional forward pass for a single denoising step. It is therefore a controlled per-step profiling proxy for comparing attention configurations, not the wall-clock runtime of a complete sampling run. Unlike training, the peak memory stays essentially flat ( ∼ \sim 49.7 49.7 GB across all settings). This is expected: inference has no backward pass, so activations are freed layer-by-layer and are not the bottleneck; the peak is instead dominated by the resident model weights and the full set of image tokens ( 82,944 82{,}944 tokens for all views), which are unchanged by the attention scope. With a memory-efficient (Flash) attention kernel the attention matrix is never materialized, so even full-global attention does not inflate memory—local attention only reshapes which tokens attend (block-diagonal per view), reducing FLOPs and latency rather than stored tensors.

blocks.en: Is Full-Global Attention Worth Its Cost? The trade-off above measures compute; here we check the matching quality side under real 2K training. We compare the full-global model (all 60 layers global) against our default global–local schedule (30 least-sensitive layers switched to local), both resumed from the same 1K checkpoint at step 6,000 6{,}000 . As shown in Figure 12 , the two curves track each other closely: after switching to local attention our schedule quickly rejoins the full-global curve and both fluctuate within a narrow band around the base, with best overall PSNR of 20.49 20.49 dB (full-global) versus 20.16 20.16 dB (global–local)—a gap of only ∼ \sim 0.33 0.33 dB. Full-global attention is thus marginally better in quality but, as quantified in Table 6 , substantially more expensive ( 90.5 90.5 GB / 299 299 s per step vs. 82.7 82.7 GB / 169 169 s at 30 local layers). Since the quality drop is small while the compute saving is large, the global–local schedule is a favorable trade-off, which is why we adopt it by default for 2K synthesis.
blocks.zh: 全球关注是否值得付出代价? 以上措施的取舍计算出来;在这里,我们通过真正的2K训练检查匹配的质量方面。 我们比较了全全球模式(全球60层)与我们默认的全球-当地时间表(30个最不敏感的层面切换到当地),两者都是从同一个1K检查站恢复的,步骤6000{}000。 如图12所示,两条曲线相互跟踪:在切换到当地注意之后,我们的时间表很快重新回到了全全球曲线,两者都在基座周围的狭长带内起伏,总体PSNR最好为20.49分贝(全全球),而20.16分贝(全球-局部)——差距仅为 \\sim 0.33分贝。 因此,全面的全球关注质量略好一些,但如表6所示,费用要高得多(每步90.5 GB/299 299 s;每分30个地层82.7 GB/169 s)。 由于质量下降幅度较小,而计算节省幅度也很大,因此全球-本地时间表是有利的取舍,因此我们默认采用2K合成。

Overall PSNR versus checkpoint step for full-global attention (all 60 layers) vs. our default global–local schedule (30 local layers). The shaded region is the shared 1K base pretraining ( 512 512 res); at step 6,000 6{,}000 both runs fork from the same base checkpoint (blue square, 19.73 19.73 dB) and are then trained for 2,000 2{,}000 steps at real 2K resolution ( 1024 × 2048 1024{\times}2048 per view). Each run reports its own best checkpoint ( ⋆ \star : 20.49 20.49 vs. 20.16 20.16 dB, a ∼ \sim 0.33 0.33 dB gap), so localizing 30 layers costs little quality while saving substantial memory and time ( Table 6 ).
